body:
# ExtendedPotions

⚡ExtendedPotions is a lightweight Paper plugin that lets you fully customize potion durations on your server.⚡

By default, vanilla potion durations can feel too short for PvP, events, survival gameplay, and custom server balancing. ExtendedPotions gives server owners complete control over potion effect lengths through an easy-to-use configuration file.

## Features

✅Fully configurable potion durations

✅Supports normal, extended, splash, and lingering potions

✅Supports both Tier I and Tier II potion variants

✅Strength and Speed potions are already extended by default

✅Easy-to-edit YAML configuration

✅Lightweight and optimized for Paper servers

✅No commands required – configure and play

✅Default Changes

ExtendedPotions ships with buffed potion durations out of the box:

🧪Strength potions extended to 6 minutes
🧪Speed potions extended to 6 minutes
🧪Splash variants last longer
🧪Lingering variants are configurable
🧪Every supported potion can be customized to fit your server

**Supported Potion Effects**

Strength
Speed / Swiftness
Regeneration
Fire Resistance
Water Breathing
Night Vision
Invisibility
Jump Boost
Slow Falling
Poison
Weakness
Slowness
Haste
Luck
Turtle Master

More potion support and features are planned for future updates.

🔧**Configuration**🔧

Every potion can have separate durations configured for:

Normal Potions
Extended Potions
Splash Potions
Lingering Potions

Example:

yaml
STRENGTH:
  tier_1:
    normal_duration: 480
    extended_duration: 480
    splash_duration: 360
    lingering_duration: 120

All durations are configured in seconds, making balancing simple and intuitive.

**Compatibility**

Server Software:Paper

Minecraft Version: 1.21.1

Additional Minecraft versions will be supported in future releases.

Why Use ExtendedPotions?

🎮Whether you're running a PvP server, SMP, Lifesteal server, event server, or a heavily customized survival experience, ExtendedPotions allows you to create potion balance that matches your gameplay instead of being limited by vanilla durations.🎮
